title: Abonelik Gerekli
purpose: Prompts the user to choose a subscription plan when gated content is accessed without an active subscription.

loading.description: Skeleton placeholder displayed while entitlement check completes.

ready.description: Plan cards (monthly and annual) are displayed with benefits list and CTAs.

empty.description: Not applicable — plan data is static.

error.description: Error state with retry action if entitlement check fails.

offline.description: Plan cards shown read-only; purchase CTAs disabled with offline notice.
